Story: Lisa Westveld is a 28-year-old backend developer and operations manager living in Amsterdam with her wife, Femke Wittemans. Raised by open-minded parents, Lisa is a confident and enthusiastic individual who thrives in her career at Katje B.V. and is surrounded by a strong support system of friends and her close cousin, Marianne Quix. She is currently the narrator of a story taking place on a month-long trip to a tropical, deserted island with her wife and friends, an experience she feels allows her to be her truest self—raw, natural, and free.
